item.aurapoints.mjolnir.tip_swing: Hold %s (Mjölnir Swing key) to spin it until lightning strikes it.
aurapoints.configuration.title: Aura Points Settings
aurapoints.configuration.shaderSafeWindC: Turn on if wind charges look black with your shader pack. They lose the scrolling wind texture but still spin.
aurapoints.configuration.auraNametags.to: Show each player's aura (like ❄ Frost ❄) above their name.
aurapoints.configuration.animations.tool: ALL: everything, your own arms in first person too. NO_FIRST_PERSON: other players and yourself in third person, your normal hand in first person. OFF: no ability animations.
aurapoints.configuration.firstPersonExtr: Show your own aura's body extras over your shoulders in first person.
aurapoints.configuration.fullBodyAnimati: Ability animations move the whole body too: leaning, twisting and planted stances, not just the arms.
Players who stand still for a while do little idle animations for their aura. Off: you never see anyone's idles.
aurapoints.configuration.idleFirstPerson: See your own idle animations' hands in first person.
aurapoints.configuration.auraTrails.tool: A soft trail in their aura's style behind sprinting players.
aurapoints.configuration.hud.tooltip: The ability panel, charge bar and crosshair marks. Tip: /aurahud lets you drag them around.
aurapoints.configuration.hudAnchor.toolt: HOTBAR: next to the hotbar. Or a screen corner, or the top middle. The offsets below move it from there.
aurapoints.configuration.hudOffsetX.tool: Moves the panel right (negative: left), in GUI pixels.
aurapoints.configuration.hudOffsetY.tool: Moves the panel down (negative: up), in GUI pixels.
aurapoints.configuration.hudLabel.toolti: Show the aura's name above the ability panel.
aurapoints.configuration.hudKeybinds.too: Show each ability's key in the corner of its slot.
aurapoints.configuration.cooldownText.to: DECIMAL: 4.5 under ten seconds. SECONDS: whole seconds. OFF: just the sweep.
aurapoints.configuration.hudEffects.tool: Little aura effects running along the panel's frame: embers, bubbles, frost glints, sparks, leaves, smoke, wind.
aurapoints.configuration.hudColor.toolti: #RRGGBB, or empty for your aura's color.
aurapoints.configuration.palette.tooltip: OFF: the auras' own colors. RED_GREEN: safe for deuteranopia/protanopia. BLUE_YELLOW: safe for tritanopia. HIGH_CONTRAST: bright colors on a black panel.
aurapoints.configuration.crosshairPips.t: Tiny cooldown dots under the crosshair, one per ability.
aurapoints.configuration.chargeBar.toolt: LEFT or RIGHT screen edge, or small next to the CROSSHAIR.
aurapoints.configuration.chargeOffsetX.t: Moves the charge bar right (negative: left), in GUI pixels.
aurapoints.configuration.chargeOffsetY.t: Moves the charge bar down (negative: up), in GUI pixels.
aurapoints.configuration.feedback.toolti: Hit marks, popups, screen edges and camera feel.
aurapoints.configuration.hitConfirm.tool: A mark on the crosshair when one of your abilities hits, bigger on a kill.
aurapoints.configuration.stuntPopups.too: Show a stunt's name on screen when you pull one off.
aurapoints.configuration.pointsToast.too: A toast in the corner when you earn Aura points.
aurapoints.configuration.rollReel.toolti: The spinning reel on screen while /aura roll picks your aura.
The screen edges show it when you're frozen, entangled, stunned, in someone's bubble or healed by Lifesteal.
aurapoints.configuration.overlayStrength: How strong those screen edges are.
aurapoints.configuration.cameraShake.too: Shake on your own big hits. 0 = none. The Abyssal Bubble's shake is part of how it works and stays.
aurapoints.configuration.fovKick.tooltip: A quick zoom punch on dashes and big hits.
aurapoints.configuration.reducedMotion.t: Turns off camera shake, zoom punches and the moving and flashing HUD extras in one go.
aurapoints.configuration.auraShimmer.too: Faint particles around players in their aura's color, stronger right after they cast. OFF, OTHERS, or ALL (you too, in third person).
aurapoints.configuration.arenaMessages.t: How arena announcements (countdowns, round won, wave cleared, knocked out...) appear: TITLE (short, in the middle of the screen) or CHAT (a chat line; countdowns go to the action bar).
A hint in chat when one of the mod's keys you need (your aura's ability keys, the Ultimate once awakened, the Item keys for datapack items) is unbound or shares its key with something else.
aurapoints.configuration.abilityVolume.t: Volume of every Aura Points sound (abilities, HUD, charge hums), on top of the game's own sliders.
aurapoints.configuration.readyChime.tool: A chime in your aura's own sound when an ability comes off cooldown.
aurapoints.configuration.notReadySound.t: A low thud when you press an ability that is still cooling down.
aurapoints.configuration.chargeHums.tool: A rising hum while you charge an ability, and a sting when it's full.
aurapoints.configuration.almostReadyTick: A soft tick in the last second of each cooldown, to time abilities by ear.
aurapoints.configuration.hitSound.toolti: A quiet sound with the hit mark, and a bell on a kill.
